title: Audit and exercise the selected kernel's allocation import ABI
goal: Test the actual NtAllocateVirtualMemory/NtFreeVirtualMemory import boundary before the lead admits the next guarded startup service; direct address-space tests do not establish the import ABI.
acceptance: Bind exact SDK, prototype, export binding and compiler identities; review implemented behavior and independent source/contract evidence before choosing expectations, marking missing retail evidence explicitly

Use original game-free guest callbacks into the actual selected kernel library, not embedded kernel objects or success stubs, to test argument/result endian handling, reserve/commit/decommit/release and alias/accounting invariants

Exercise null, unaligned, out-of-range and wrapping in/out pointers, invalid size/type/protection and release-state failures without corrupting neighbouring guest memory or returning success for unsupported behavior

Retain baseline failures and result mutations, and split any demonstrated SDK repair into an agreed child scope; this task changes no SDK, shared harness, guest service allowlist or generated game code
validation: Run isolated and repeated orders on native Windows/Linux and supported host/core sanitizers, checking actual loaded library identities and resource recovery
Reject an intentionally wrong result and an incomplete/late process; report supported skips and distinguish original contract tests from actual MW3 calls
Run public game-free checks; publish exact evidence and unresolved differences, with no later startup, gameplay or full kernel-parity claim
size: bounded ABI contracts; split SDK repairs
evidence: Lead blocker resolution: MW3-091 merged in PR135 (297d742); the verified allocation-import safety derivative is complete. MW3-046 is ready for a serialized claim and explicit consumer adoption, with acceptance still incomplete.
